name: Amnext prize strategy draws winners from a blockhash seed known to the completer
summary: Amnext's PoolTogether V3 fork MultipleWinners lets anyone call completeAward(), whose seed comes from RNGBlockhash.randomNumber(), i.e. blockhash(block.number - 1), known before the caller's transaction runs. After depositing for a ticket share and starting the award, the attacker completed it in a block whose seed made every draw land on its contract, then withdrew the prize.
notes: The MultipleWinners clone was created and initialized with rng = RNGBlockhash in the pool-builder tx and setRngService was never called, so the clone's creation sets the age; the shared RNGBlockhash is older.

AMC is valued at the attacker's realised price (its 371.9M AMC sale halved the PancakeSwap price): 154.017 WBNB pro rata, applied to the 330.45M AMC prize (attacker deposit excluded, exit fee not subtracted) and to the copycat's 116,023 AMC prize.

Copycats completed awards with chosen blockhash seeds on sibling Amnext pools (AMC, BUSD/vBNB and USDT pools, same builder and owner) within hours; found as RNGBlockhash.randomNumber callers after the anchor whose winner was the caller's contract.
